Docs.summary:
Registers the lazy resilient-task services, optionally supplying the hosted-storage credential. Calling AddResilientTask/AddResilientMultiTurnTask directly also performs this setup on first use, but neither registration path enables execution or recovery. Call
before host startup to opt in. This method only needs to be called explicitly to supply a hosted credential. The credential may be supplied before or after task registrations while composing the service collection. A registered directly in the service collection is also supported; when both forms are used they must resolve to the same instance.
